description: Énergie: consommation, production et Plan d'Action pour l'Efficacité Energétique (PAEE) de WalStat is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by IWEPS WalStat. Les indicateurs communaux sur l’énergie présentés ici sont calculés pour les Bilans communaux du SPW Territoire, Logement, Patrimoine, Énergie. Remarque: les bilans communaux impliquent l'usage de données agrégées communalisées, nécessitant la formulations de diverses hypothèses. Se référer à la note méthodologique pour plus d’informations. Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal files it under Administration et Services publics, Energie. Its keywords are énergie, consommation, énergie, production, énergie, statistiques. The portal shows 289 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons - CC0 (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
